name: signal-marquee
title: Signal Marquee
description: An original, pauseable signal ribbon for concise product proof and supporting navigation.
useWhen: You need a calm, compact stream of product signals or supporting proof.
avoidWhen: Critical information must remain stationary or users need to compare every item at once.
responsiveBehavior: The ribbon stays in one horizontal line at wide sizes and wraps into a static, readable list when reduced motion is requested.
accessibility: Pauses on hover and keyboard focus.
Shows the complete content without animation when reduced motion is requested.

variants.title: Signal ribbon
variants.description: A clean continuous ribbon with concise product signals, edge fades, and pause behavior.
accessibility: Pause animation on hover and focus.
Do not rely on movement to convey essential content.
